body.x: PPYPLE(representative Sang-sin Kim www.pplple.com) will introduce docking station 'Swing ball i' supporting view from varied angles at CES 2012 held in Las Vegas, US, from Jan 10-13.

Docking station 'Swing Ball i' supports view from varied angles by rotating front part. With turning front part, it offers optimal view. User can enjoy their cellphone in varied environment such as on the desk, sofa, bed, and others.

In particular, famous designer group Ugly duckling participated in design process, so this product is created as Pop art design harmonized with place for daily life. There are 4 colors of baby pink, sky blue, light gray, dark silver.
